	 * power well, so hpd is reinitialized from there. For

	if (!IS_VALLEYVIEW(dev_priv) && !IS_CHERRYVIEW(dev_priv)) {

		drm_err(&dev_priv->drm,

	else
		drm_dbg(&dev_priv->drm, "Device resumed\n");

	return ret;
}

## PCI PM callbacks that reach `i915_pm_suspend`

Only the `.suspend` callback itself and the hibernation `.poweroff` callback reach `i915_pm_suspend`:

```text
PCI PM core
 ├─ i915_pm_ops.suspend
 │    └─ i915_pm_suspend(kdev)
 │         ├─ i915 = kdev_to_i915(kdev)
 │         ├─ switch_power_state == DRM_SWITCH_POWER_OFF?
 │         │    └─ yes: return 0
 │         └─ i915_drm_suspend(&i915->drm)
 │
 └─ i915_pm_ops.poweroff
      └─ i915_pm_suspend(kdev)
           ├─ i915 = kdev_to_i915(kdev)
           ├─ switch_power_state == DRM_SWITCH_POWER_OFF?
           │    └─ yes: return 0
           └─ i915_drm_suspend(&i915->drm)
```

Relevant assignments:

```c
.suspend = i915_pm_suspend,       /* i915_driver.c:1719 */
.poweroff = i915_pm_suspend,      /* i915_driver.c:1747 */
```

The implementation is at `i915_driver.c:1379` approximately:

```c
static int i915_pm_suspend(struct device *kdev)
{
	struct drm_i915_private *i915 = kdev_to_i915(kdev);

	if (!i915)
		return -ENODEV;

	if (i915->drm.switch_power_state == DRM_SWITCH_POWER_OFF)
		return 0;

	return i915_drm_suspend(&i915->drm);
}
```

## Full common call chain

For both `.suspend` and `.poweroff`:

```text
PCI PM core
  → i915_pm_ops.suspend / i915_pm_ops.poweroff
    → i915_pm_suspend(struct device *kdev)
      → kdev_to_i915(kdev)
      → i915_drm_suspend(struct drm_device *dev)
        → to_i915(dev)
        → dev_priv->display
        → intel_display_driver_suspend(display)
          → drm_atomic_helper_suspend(display->drm)
```

Inside `i915_drm_suspend()` (`i915_driver.c:1103`), the relevant sequence is:

```c
struct drm_i915_private *dev_priv = to_i915(dev);
struct intel_display *display = dev_priv->display;

intel_power_domains_disable(display);
drm_client_dev_suspend(dev);
...
intel_display_driver_suspend(display);
...
intel_irq_suspend(dev_priv);
...
intel_dpt_suspend(display);
i915_ggtt_suspend(to_gt(dev_priv)->ggtt);
...
```

`intel_display_driver_suspend()` is the actual symbol in this tree; there is no `intel_display_suspend` match. It is implemented in:

- `drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_display_driver.c:684`

Its call chain is:

```text
intel_display_driver_suspend(display)
  → if (!HAS_DISPLAY(display))
        return 0
  → drm_atomic_helper_suspend(display->drm)
  → store returned state in display->restore.modeset_state
  → flush_workqueue(display->wq.cleanup)
  → intel_dp_mst_suspend(display)
```

There is no `i915_pm_runtime_suspend` symbol in this source tree; grep found no such function or callback.
